metadata.title: Candid Studio Portrait with Gradient Backdrop

recipe.visualDefinition: A waist-up studio portrait of a young man with dark curly hair, captured in a moment of intense laughter with eyes closed and mouth wide open. He is wearing a distressed white t-shirt and thin silver and gold necklaces, set against a smooth vertical gradient background transitioning from deep cerulean blue at the top to a pale, almost white-blue at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's head is tilted back and to the side, creating a dynamic diagonal line against the static background.
High-key lighting on the subject's face and shirt contrasts sharply with the saturated blue of the upper background.
The texture of the curly hair and distressed fabric provides tactile detail against the smooth, grain-free gradient.
coreInvariants: Candid, joyful facial expression with open mouth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, framed from the waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's open mouth and teeth serve as the primary focal point due to high contrast and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright white t-shirt, moves up the necklaces to the laughing face, and follows the head tilt toward the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the gradient background on either side of the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue gradient (background) providing a cool, calm atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (t-shirt) providing a clean, high-key anchor.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle gold jewelry providing organic warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the upper background fades to low saturation at the bottom; the subject is rendered with naturalistic, medium-contrast values.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blues, whites, and natural skin tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio portrait of a man with dark curly hair laughing heartily, eyes closed, head tilted. He wears a white t-shirt with small distressed holes. The background is a clean vertical gradient from deep blue at the top to light blue-white at the bottom. Use soft, even studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, minimalist sans-serif font in white or a very light blue, positioned in the negative space of the upper corners to maintain the focus on the expression.

verificationChecks: Is the gradient smooth without banding?
Is the laughter expression genuine and not forced?
Are the distressed details on the shirt subtle and realistic?
Is the lighting soft enough to avoid harsh shadows on the face?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distressing on the t-shirt
mustRedesign: Avoid any logos on the t-shirt
Ensure the background is a pure gradient without environmental textures
Maintain a candid, non-posed feel to the laughter
postGenerationChecks: Verify the gradient transition is seamless.
Ensure the teeth and mouth interior look natural.
Check that the necklaces are rendered as fine, distinct lines.
Confirm the hair texture is detailed and not a solid mass.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-energy candid human expression with a minimalist, two-tone vertical gradient background to create a professional yet intimate editorial portrait.
